title: The Creatures of the Midnight Sea
intro: This quiz follows Nila and Owen as they learn how deep-sea creatures survive in darkness, cold water, and high pressure.

questions.prompt: What special feature does an anglerfish use to attract prey?
choices: A glowing lure on its head
questions.explanation: An anglerfish uses a glowing lure on its head to attract prey.

choices: The ability of an animal to swim quickly
Light made by a living organism
questions.explanation: Bioluminescence is light made by a living organism.

questions.prompt: Why do some deep-sea creatures produce light?
choices: To attract food, scare predators, or find one another
To make the water less salty
questions.explanation: Some deep-sea creatures produce light to attract food, scare predators, or find one another.

questions.prompt: What conditions are found in the deep sea?
choices: Dark, cold, and under high pressure
Hot, sandy, and filled with trees
questions.explanation: The deep sea is dark, cold, and under high pressure.

questions.prompt: Which adaptation helps some deep-sea animals survive?
choices: Large eyes, stretchy mouths, soft bodies, or special ways to save energy
questions.explanation: Large eyes, stretchy mouths, soft bodies, or special ways to save energy help some deep-sea animals survive.
